## Trigger

Composing `PhoneApp` on the `ImportPreview`/`PasteError` destinations, and
on every composition (for the `LocalContext` read) — observed.
Decoding a payload received over the Data Layer, via
`PayloadCodec.decodeProfileSync`/`decodeRecordedRace` — observed.
Constructing `HapticFeedbackImpl`, at Hilt injection — observed.

## Today

`PhoneApp`, in `MainActivity.kt`, performs three unchecked casts:
- line 100, `LocalContext.current as ComponentActivity` — throws if the
  composition's context is not itself a `ComponentActivity`.
- line 120, on the `ImportPreview` branch,
  `pasteResultUiState.lastParseResult as HyresultParseResult.Success` —
  `lastParseResult` is a nullable `sealed interface HyresultParseResult`
  with two members, `Success` and `Failure`
  (`core-domain/.../HyresultResultParser.kt`); the cast is safe only
  because `PhoneNavigator` is trusted to route to `ImportPreview` solely
  after a `Success`, a discipline enforced nowhere in the type system —
  a `null` or a `Failure` read at this point throws.
- line 132, on the `PasteError` branch, the mirror cast to
  `HyresultParseResult.Failure`, same risk.

`PayloadCodec`'s private `ByteArray.toObject<T>()` (line 48,
`it.readObject() as T`), used by both `decodeProfileSync` and
`decodeRecordedRace`, casts whatever `ObjectInputStream.readObject()`
deserialises to the reified type `T` with no check; bytes produced for
one snapshot type but read as another throw a `ClassCastException`
instead of a typed decoding failure.

`HapticFeedbackImpl` (line 28),
`context.getSystemService(Context.VIBRATOR_SERVICE) as Vibrator` — the
platform documents `getSystemService` as returning `null` when the
service is absent on the device; the non-null cast throws instead of
falling back to a no-op, which the class already implements for
"device reports no vibrator" via `hasVibrator()` but never reaches if
construction itself throws.

## Expected

Each of the five casts handles the shape it does not expect instead of
throwing: `PhoneApp` guards the `ComponentActivity` cast and both
`HyresultParseResult` casts so an unexpected context or parse-result
state does not crash composition; `PayloadCodec.toObject` turns a
mismatched deserialised type into the codec's own typed decoding
failure rather than a raw `ClassCastException`; `HapticFeedbackImpl`
tolerates an absent `Vibrator` service the same way it already
tolerates `hasVibrator() == false`, construction included.
